usage_requirements: Cross-encoder: input is (query, passage) text pairs; outputs a scalar relevance score directly, not embeddings
No query/passage prefixes or instructions needed ('no instruction needs to be added to passages')
Raw scores are unbounded (trained with cross-entropy loss); pass normalize=True to FlagReranker.compute_score (or apply sigmoid manually) to map scores to [0,1]
Max input length 512 tokens per pair (XLM-RoBERTa base, max_position_embeddings=514)
Loadable via FlagEmbedding FlagReranker, sentence-transformers CrossEncoder, or transformers AutoModelForSequenceClassification (num_labels=1); trust_remote_code NOT required
use_fp16=True recommended for faster inference with minimal quality loss
known_issues: Score range confusion is a recurring user issue: raw logits fluctuate widely and are not comparable to a 0-1 scale without sigmoid normalization (FlagOpen/FlagEmbedding issue #965)
Only supports Chinese and English; BAAI recommends the bge-reranker-v2 series (e.g. bge-reranker-v2-m3) for multilingual or newer use cases — this model is a prior generation
Cross-encoder design is 'more accurate but less efficient' than bi-encoders; intended only for re-ranking a top-k candidate set, not full-corpus scoring
unknowns: embedding_dim (not applicable: cross-encoder outputs a scalar score, no embedding output; hidden size is 768 but that is not an embedding dimension)
independent (non-BAAI) benchmark verification: all C-MTEB reranking numbers trace to BAAI's own model card/leaderboard submission
